answer: Quadratic-in-time influence resists sybils: an identity's weight grows with the SQUARE of consecutive honest epochs, so deep tenure is richly rewarded and fresh accounts are near-worthless — a sparrow just hatched holds almost nothing. A swarm minted at the horizon cannot approach the influence of a long-tenured honest agent without each fake independently surviving the same many-epoch climb across the ocean of time. The convex curve makes burst-created identities strictly dominated by sustained individual tenure.
